Mercimek Soup.note: Butter = milk; bread = gluten; celery. Chicken stock: not vegetarian although it sounds it. Pul biber chilli butter, 'mild' = 1.

Hummus.note: Tahini = sesame; lavash = wheat. Merchant tag vegan.

Haydari.note: Strained yoghurt = milk; walnuts = tree nuts (hidden in a dip); lavash = wheat.

Ezme.note: Vegetables, pepper, pomegranate molasses; no bread. 'very spicy' = 3.

Meze Platter.note: Hummus and babaganoush tahini = sesame; haydari and babaganoush yoghurt = milk; haydari walnuts = tree nuts; lavash = wheat. No ezme, no chilli.

Mercimek Kofte.note: 'Kofte' but lentil and bulgur (wheat) patties: vegan. Isot pepper, 'mild' = 1.

Adana Kebab.note: Bulgur pilav = wheat + butter; lavash = wheat. 'spicy' = 2. Signature.

Urfa Kebab.note: Rice pilav with wheat vermicelli (hidden gluten) and butter. 'not spicy' = 0.

Chicken Shish Kebab.note: Yoghurt marinade = milk; rice pilav with wheat vermicelli and butter. Sweet paprika: 0.

Lamb Shish Kebab.note: Rice pilav with wheat vermicelli and butter.

Iskender Kebab.note: Pide bread = wheat; butter and yoghurt = milk. Signature.

Mixed Grill for Two.note: Pilavs stated with wheat and butter; lavash; chicken shish yoghurt. Includes spicy adana = 2.

Grilled Sea Bass.note: Fish only; rocket and sumac onion. The only gluten-free and milk-free main.

Kiymali Pide.note: Wheat flatbread; egg wash = egg. No cheese.

Kasarli Pide.note: Wheat; kasar cheese and butter = milk; egg.

Sucuklu Pide.note: Wheat; beef sucuk (no pork); kasar cheese = milk; egg. 'mildly spicy' = 1.

Chicken Doner Wrap.note: Lavash = wheat; garlic yoghurt sauce = milk. 'not spicy' = 0.

Beef Doner Wrap.note: Lavash = wheat; garlic mayonnaise = egg (no dairy). Hot chilli sauce, 'spicy' = 2.

Imam Bayildi.note: Plain bulgur = wheat. Merchant tag vegan.

Rice Pilav.note: Sounds plain: chicken stock (not vegetarian), butter = milk, sehriye wheat vermicelli = gluten.

Bulgur Pilav.note: Cracked wheat; butter. Vegetable stock: vegetarian, not vegan. Sweet pepper paste: 0.

Shepherd Salad.note: Vegetables, olive oil, lemon, pomegranate molasses. Green pepper is not chilli.

Kunefe.note: Kataifi = wheat; cheese and butter = milk; pistachio = tree nuts. Cheese dish, vegetarian by ingredients (rennet not stated, v4/v5 convention). Signature.

Baklava.note: Filo = wheat; butter = milk; pistachio = tree nuts.

Sutlac.note: Milk; ground hazelnut = tree nuts (hidden). Rice and rice flour, no wheat.

Turkish Delight Plate.note: Pistachio = tree nuts. Corn starch set, no gelatine: vegan (merchant tag).

Turkish Coffee.note: Coffee itself is plain, but it is served with pistachio lokum = tree nuts (hidden).

Salgam.note: Made with bulgur = wheat (hidden gluten in a juice). Lactic fermentation, no alcohol stated: halal. 'not spicy' = 0.
